llm_analysis.reasoning: The core embedded C/C++ firmware skills the JD leads with are genuinely strong and well backed by real register-level STM32 work. The gap is on the commercial productization side this specific employer cares about: control-panel-level design and taking a board from prototype into volume manufacturing with a production team. That gap is normal for a new grad and likely acceptable at the entry level this posting targets (1-3 yrs preferred), but it means the 100% keyword match overstates actual readiness — this reads closer to a genuine 60-65% holistic fit.
